description: An HR business partner must decide whether and how to restore two employees to joint work after a collaboration breakdown, including communication boundaries, meeting preparation, documentation, and a follow-up review.

shared_context.S1: Mira and Jon's collaboration broke down during preparation for a major product launch.
shared_context.S2: Their current interim arrangement keeps Mira on written deliverables and Jon on live coordination, with no shared working meetings.
shared_context.S3: Elena has authority to change the interim arrangement and set the conditions for resuming joint work.
shared_context.S4: As part of Elena's standard reset process, she speaks with each employee before documenting a joint working plan and scheduling a follow-up review.

PF1.text: Mira will resume joint work only if, for the first 14 days after the reset, all communication with Jon stays in the shared project channel, meeting agendas are written and sent at least 24 hours ahead, and Elena schedules a review exactly 14 days after the restart.

PF2.text: Jon has kept a dated record showing that he interrupted Mira in exactly 3 launch-preparation meetings, and he is prepared to give Mira a written apology naming those 3 incidents before they resume joint work.

acceptance_conditions: Joint work must be restored under a documented reset plan.
For the first 14 days, communication between Mira and Jon must use the shared project channel rather than direct messages.
Written meeting agendas must be sent at least 24 hours in advance.
Jon's record of exactly 3 interruptions must be included in the working-plan record.
Jon must give Mira a written apology naming the 3 interruptions before joint work resumes.
Elena must schedule the follow-up review exactly 14 days after the restart.

content_checks.C5: any(c['type'] == 'written_apology' and c['target'] == 'Mira' and c['detail'] == 'names 3 interruptions before joint work resumes' for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed
provenance_checks.P2: 'PF2' in credited_facts and 'PF2' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF2' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: Mira's stated condition changes the reset from an unspecified return to joint work into restoration with shared-channel-only communication, exactly 24 hours of agenda notice, and a review exactly 14 days after restart.

Jon's dated record changes the working-plan record from no specified interruption count to exactly 3, and his commitment changes the repair plan to a written apology naming those 3 incidents before resumption.
